judged_text: add_members silently skips usernames that don't match a user (`if user = User.find_by_username(username)`) and does not trim whitespace, then renders success_json regardless of how many were skipped. An admin or API caller submitting a typo'd or padded username (e.g. 'bob, jane ') gets 200 success while only some users were added, with no indication which were skipped; the diff also deleted the old tests that documented this silent-skip behavior without adding an equivalent assertion on the new endpoint.

An admin or API caller submitting a typo'd or padded username (e.g. 'bob, jane ') gets 200 success while only some users were added, with no indication which were skipped; the diff also deleted the old tests that documented this silent-skip behavior without adding an equivalent assertion on the new endpoint.

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, usernames are processed via `usernames.split(",").each` and then `User.find_by_username(username)` with no `strip`, so padded values like `" jane "` will be skipped. The method then renders `success_json` as long as `group.save` succeeds, regardless of how many usernames were skipped, giving callers no indication of partial/zero adds. The previous spec coverage for silent skipping of non-existent users (in the old PATCH-based incremental update tests) was removed and no equivalent assertion was added for the new `add_members` endpoint.
